body.x: TYPO(typokeyboards.com) announced 'TYPO Keyboard Case' at 'Showstoppers' of CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Typo Keyboard was made for more efficiency in my mobile communications, especially for the busy professionals. The Typo Keyboard, available first for the iPhone 5/ 5S, adds just short of 1/8 of an inch in thickness and 1/2 an inch in total length to the iPhone, while providing an unrivaled typing experience. This is made possible by miniaturizing the components on the circuit board, using patented Typo Touch keyboard technology and one of the world's smallest Lithium-ion batteries, measuring at just 1mm in thickness.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
